note: Hard role and minimum-effort policy. Profile descriptions are heuristics, not benchmark results. Filter by authenticated provider, actual supported levels and tool transport.

profiles.criteria: Review only: inspect changes and evidence, find correctness or boundary issues, and deliver actionable findings with file locations. Default starting profile for review.
Review only: exceptionally complex interacting systems, concurrency or security boundaries needing maximum deliberation; latency is secondary.
GPT-6 Sol for demanding but bounded module debugging or refactoring with linked constraints and evidence to reconcile.
GPT-6 Sol for unusually difficult coding or agentic tasks requiring extended reasoning within an established design; latency is secondary.
Maximum GPT-6 Sol deliberation for exceptional bounded engineering problems; higher effort is not a guaranteed capability upgrade.
GPT-6 Luna for focused problems needing extra checking or several local reasoning steps, with little architectural ambiguity and verifiable outcomes.
GPT-6 Luna trial profile for difficult but narrow, well-constrained problems. Use when extra reasoning on the focused model is worth testing.
Maximum GPT-6 Luna deliberation for exceptional focused tasks with strong acceptance checks. Do not assume this substitutes for Sol on broad ambiguous work.
